title: The Playing Fields of Grit
coreMove: Choose a hard thing you care about, finish the season, and let follow-through become identity.
sourcePressure: Use structured hard activities as training grounds for interest plus perseverance.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Thinking any busy extracurricular or forced activity builds grit.

sourceAnchors.name: Hard Thing Rule
sourceAnchors.detail: Duckworth’s family rule requires everyone to choose a hard activity, finish the season or semester, and choose their own hard thing.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The rule works because the door is chosen freely but not opened early.

sourceAnchors.name: Warren Willingham follow-through study
sourceAnchors.detail: Willingham tracked students and found follow-through in extracurriculars strongly predicted later college and achievement outcomes.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Willingham treated the after-school record as evidence of a habit: staying with something when novelty is gone.
